preconditions.description: The number of routers is between 2 and 200000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= p_i < i for all i in range(2, n+1)
preconditions.description: Each p_i is the index of the router to which the i-th router was connected after being purchased.

postconditions.description: The output contains the path from the 1st to the n-th router, with each element distinct.
The path starts with the 1st router.
The path ends with the n-th router.
All elements in the output are distinct.
